The M82A2 is a rare, prototype bullpup version of the Barrett M82A1, an Anti-Materiel Rifle (AMR), designed for shoulder firing to compensate for heavy recoil. It features a pistol grip and trigger ahead of the magazine, hence the bullpup design, it also has a buttpad below the receiver and a forward grip. Only a small number were ever manufactured, primarily for testing. Comes with a 29-inch (73cm) barrel.
